name: Robert Garcia
page_title: Robert Garcia's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Democratic for U.S. House (CA) - District 42

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: "Access to abortion services is critical healthcare for many women. What’s happening in Texas is horrific and a direct attack on Roe and rights for women nationwide. We must work to elect a more progressive legislature and Governor."

"As a member of Congress I’ll vote to codify Roe, expand funding for planned parenthood and healthcare providers, and support abortion access in all 50 states. I’ll also advocate to eliminate the filibuster and work like hell to elect representatives that support abortion care."

"Honored to be endorsed today by Planned Parenthood. @PPact is working to expand access to reproductive healthcare in all 50 states. In Congress I’ll vote to codify Roe and always stand with women and people who need access to abortion care. Thank you!"
Rated 100% by Planned Parenthood Action Fund

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "In 2021 we also passed a guaranteed income pilot program, providing 500 single parents living in poverty and struggling to meet basic needs with $500 a month. In Congress, I will fight to protect and expand eligibility and benefits for Medicaid, Social Security and Medicare. Every parent should be able to afford child care, and I believe every parent should be able to send their kids to a quality pre-k provider. I’ll fight for universal child care and pre-k in Congress."

"The President did a great job protecting Medicaid, Social Security and student loan relief in this deal. But we need to ensure that working and low income families are protected in the bill. We cannot allow House Republicans to hold the economy hostage again."
"We will will not allow Kevin McCarthy and Marjorie Taylor Greene to destroy Medicare and Social Security. People work hard for their benefits and we will work hard to ensure they receive them."

positions.question: Do you support the regulation of indirect campaign contributions from corporations, unions, and individuals?

evidence.text: "End Citizens United: I strongly believe in ending Citizens United. I am refusing corporate PAC checks in my campaign."
"Our campaign is powered by grassroots supporters. We take no corporate PAC money, and are fighting to take dark money out of politics."

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "I’ve worked to adopt progressive policies that address racism within government and our institutions. We launched an office of equity, have worked to diversify our leadership and commissions, and have integrated programs like My Brothers Keeper across the city. I strongly support the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act, and I will fight to modernize and expand our anti-discrimination laws."

"Justice has been served today and our love goes out to George Floyd’s family. The jury absolutely did the right thing. We know there is so much more to do to break down racial injustice and achieve equity for all. I am hopeful this verdict can be a turning point for our country."
"Speaker McCarthy MUST bring the George Floyd Justice in Policing Act to the floor immediately."

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: Voted against of HR 4365: "Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2024"
"Just voted hell NO on the Defense Authorization Act. What a terrible piece of legislation."
Voted against HR 2670: "National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024"

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: "Proud to be a co-sponsor to reintroduce the #GreenNewDeal in Congress. Let’s work to expand and decarbonize public transit, build electric infrastructure, and create good union jobs."

"The #AmericanJobsPlan is a bold vision to rebuild our nation’s roads, airports, ports, and bridges. These projects will create and support good union jobs and unleash an economic recovery. Long Beach is ready to get to work. Thank you, Mr. President."

"The #AmericanJobsPlan will boost infrastructure spending in our state and city, rebuild bridges and our port, expand broadband in low income communities, support public transit, and sustain and create good local jobs. We are ready."

"The infrastructure bill means tens of millions of new investments in Long Beach including roads, broadband, our bridges, port, and airport. It’s a historic opportunity to create good local construction jobs and rebuild our country. Mayors are ready to put this money to work."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "Housing and cities are going to be a key focus of my work in congress. What could we do at the federal level to maximize housing production, lower costs for tenants, and create successful density?"

"Housing is a Human Right: We must expand affordable and accessible housing across the United States and work to build quality public housing. We need to ensure that people who are unhoused have access to shelter, services, and permanent supportive housing. Congress has an opportunity to fund significant housing development across American cities, especially along public transit and urban job centers."

"This morning I submitted the People over Parking Act, a bill in the U.S. House that eliminates parking minimums across the country in transit rich zones. We are in a housing crisis and eliminating parking requirements lowers costs to build. It’s good housing & climate policy."
"We can build more affordable housing and become more sustainable by eliminating parking minimums in transit zones. Let’s get this done."

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "Incredible to see this historic climate and inflation reduction bill pass the Senate. We have much more work to do to address climate, prescription drug prices, and fair taxes - but this legislation is an enormous step forward. A big win for working people and the planet."

"President Biden is once again delivering major wins for the American people with the Inflation Reduction Act. Each piece of this legislation on prescription drug prices, climate, and corporate taxes is significant on its own. Together, they mark an enormous step forward."

"This jobs report is incredible for American cities. It’s the largest annual job growth in history. The work isn’t done, and we still have to get down inflation and lift wages for workers - but this Biden Boom is the real deal."

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "When we cancel student debt we are going to unlock immense potential in our country - especially from young students who took on debt to survive. It’s going to boom our economy and kick-start a new era where young people can save and support themselves and their families."

"Cancel Student Debt & Make College Cost Free: In Long Beach, we launched the Long Beach College Promise giving thousands of students two years of free tuition at Long Beach Community College. In Congress, I will fight to cancel student debt across America and fight for no-cost college for all our students."

"Canceling student loan debt with no means test is one of the best ways to stimulate the economy. And we can pay for it by taxing the billionaires that received massive tax cuts under this administration."

"It’s clear from reporting that @VP Harris played a key role in advocating for student debt cancellation from inside the White House. Since her days as Attorney General here in California she has always advocated for the people. Thank you MVP!"

positions.question: Do you support requiring a government-issued identification in order to vote at the polls?

evidence.text: "Expand the court, eliminate the filibuster, and expand voting rights. Time is running out and our democracy is in serious danger. The Senate needs to act immediately"
"It’s past time to abolish the filibuster and pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Act."

"The most important issue facing Congress today is to defend our democracy against attacks from the extreme far-right. I support the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act and the Freedom to Vote Act."
"There’s nothing more important than voting rights and Congress should make it our top priority. Our democracy and America as we know it is at stake."

positions.question: Do you support government funding for the development of renewable energy (e.g. solar, wind, geo-thermal)?

evidence.text: "Create New Jobs While Transitioning Away From Fossil Fuels: I strongly support the Green New Deal. During my time as mayor, Long Beach has worked locally to invest in green jobs and lower emissions drastically, ahead of state standards. We have lauded a citywide youth climate corps, electrified our buses and fleet, and expanded multimodal bike and transit. I have also signed the No Fossil Fuel Money pledge."
"Proud to be a co-sponsor to reintroduce the #GreenNewDeal in Congress. Let’s work to expand and decarbonize public transit, build electric infrastructure, and create good union jobs."

"The Build Back Better Act is a historic investment in climate protection. It also creates a civilian climate corps focused on green jobs to power our future economy. We are launching a youth climate corps early next year in our city to prepare for this landmark investment."

positions.question: Do you generally support gun-control legislation (e.g. red flag laws, boyfriend loopholes)?

evidence.text: "As a former mayor I can assure you that law enforcement leadership and chiefs of police support common sense gun safety legislation. We need to get these assault rifles off the street."

"Congress must take action to save lives with responsible gun safety legislation. I will work to implement universal background checks and a ban on AR-15 assault weapons. We must also raise the national age requirement to own a firearm to 21 and create a strong national licensing program. Communities and schools must also receive federal support for expanded mental health programs and violence diversion programs."
Rated 0% by Gun Owners of America

positions.question: Do you support a government-run (e.g. single-payer) healthcare program, such as Medicare-for-All?

evidence.text: "I'm not sure who needs to hear this, but healthcare should not be linked to your employment. Medicare for All."

"In Washington D.C. kicking off our progressive caucus orientation for freshman. These new members are going to lead the fight for immigration reform, Medicare for All, union rights, climate action, and increasing the minimum wage. Let’s go!"

"Medicare for All: I believe the best approach to fixing our healthcare system is passing Medicare for All. I am a longtime supporter of Medicare for All and serve as the co-chair of Mayors 4 Medicare. I pushed for the City of Long Beach to be on the record supporting Medicare for All. Healthcare is a human right and your coverage shouldn’t depend on your employment."

positions.question: Do you support expanding paid family AND/OR medical leave benefits (e.g. maternity leave)?

evidence.text: "I want to thank Councilwoman Pearce for her service to Long Beach and especially her advocacy for women, our LGBTQ community, and working families. She has been a leader in adopting short term rental policy & paid family leave. There’s still a lot of work to do in the year ahead."
"I’m really proud of the City Council for unanimously adopting one of the most comprehensive packages to protect workers & small businesses in the state: paid sick leave"

positions.question: Do you support increasing security along the southern US border?
